name.en: Habelia optata — morph A inspired whole animal
name.zh: 哈贝尔虫（Habelia optata，A形态启发）

scope: Original static complete animal informed by actual whole fossils; not same-specimen replica, scientific scan or new inventory slot. Morph A only; never combine morph A/B spines.

scale.basis: Nominal artist values. Body length selected within published 8.5–34 mm range, excluding telson. Posed bounds/width/height are not specimen measurements.

pose: Quiet low stance, head -Y, near-straight two-piece telson +Y; lateral appendages separated sufficiently to read. No rock, base, labels or props.

coordinates.origin: Horizontal animal bounds center; lowest intended foot support at Z=0.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: 4–5 restrained slate/ochre shades plus dark eyes; no claim of fossil color.
surface_profile.detail: Low-poly coherent closed solids. Sparse tubercle highlights, no noisy uniformly spiked sphere assembly. Solid tapered lamellar fringe simplification; never alpha cards.

morphology.obligation: Broad domed head shield; paired notch-set lateral eyes, not long eye stalks; twelve trunk tergites. First five trunk segments carry walking legs, segments6–12 smaller paddles.
Seven cephalic appendage pairs: reduced frontal pair; five gnathobase/raptorial units with slender exopod branches; posterior thoracic-like pair. Preserve organized fan, not giant single pincers.

Bipartite telson approximately body length; shorter distal piece roughly one-third proximal. MorphA has three prominent anterior dorsal spine levels; preserve bilateral projections and subdued posterior relief.

scientific_limits: Fossils are compressed; full depth, posture, pigment, minute setal densities and articulation clearances are interpretive.
Use observed whole fossils Fig1d/g and interpretive Fig3; diagram is not specimen photograph or mesh template.

Article family diagnosis says eight posterior segments despite total12 and anterior5; use explicit species description and segment6–12 passage (seven), not an invented13th. The2018 correction does not resolve that line.
Head-branch attachment, reduced frontal tip and posterior endopods remain uncertain. Use restrained connections; no asserted nerves, internal organs, inferred behavior or universal coexistence.

view_plan.final_source: Clean import of exact delivered GLB; save camera/light config and hash-bound manifest.
view_plan.extra_views: None by default. Only a specific unresolved factual or technical issue justifies one focused diagnostic.

acceptance_obligations: Preserve whole-body silhouette, twelve tergites and bipartite long telson; do not silently substitute Sanctacaris/Leanchoilia meshes.
Four fixed final views suffice for this scoped static task. Front checks paired head organization, side three spine levels and tail break, top segment/lateral outline, perspective coherent depth.

EXPORT contains exactly one asset-named identity root, intended meshes descendants only. Cameras/lights outside. Applied positive transforms, outward winding, single-sided OPAQUE materials; no DoubleSide workaround.
Default shared helper thresholds unchanged. Use current asset_common and exactGLB renderer; record dependency hashes/runtime/exporter versions.

Two COMPLETE isolated factory-startup rebuilds from same generator/config/seed, compare exact GLB SHA256 AND decoded geometry/material semantic digest, bounds/counts. Two exports of one scene do not qualify.
Editable .blend reopen/reexport verification plus native/export metrics, Khronos validation and scoped runtime parse. Preserve all logs.
Independent QA separate from maker. GPU-world/user acceptance/merge/deploy not run and not prerequisites to begin static making; never claim them passed.
production_plan: Coordinator claims existing habelia slot after current duplicate recheck. Maker reads real pixels locally before geometry.
Create new generator/config with named parameters and fixed seed; build continuous carapace and tail first, then mapped appendages.
Check four cheap graybox views before detail; correct silhouette first. No eight-view or animation expansion.
Apply controlled palette; export single identity root with default helper and run complete two-build reproducibility.
Hand exact GLB/Blend/source/ref manifest and four views to separate reviewer. No upload/publish authority from this preparation.
required_deliverables: real-reference ledger with private source pixels
two full build logs and byte/semantic comparison
